objects.name: US agencies warn of AI-powered attacks on Siemens industrial controllers
objects.description: Threat actors are using AI to write exploit scripts targeting internet-exposed Siemens S7 Series programmable logic controllers (PLCs) used across water, energy, manufacturing, and other critical infrastructure sectors, according to US federal agencies.
